title: Pulmonary Rehabilitation for COPD — Exercise Is the Treatment

hook.en: People with COPD stop moving because they get breathless, then get more breathless because they stop moving. Pulmonary rehabilitation breaks this spiral, and it improves breathlessness and quality of life more than most medicines. Learn how to assess, train and keep these patients safe.
hook.ur: COPD ke mareez saans phoolne ki wajah se harkat chhor dete hain, phir harkat chhorne se aur zyada saans phoolti hai. Pulmonary rehabilitation is chakkar ko torti hai, aur saans aur zindagi ke maiyar ko aksar dawaiyon se zyada behtar karti hai. Seekhein in mareezon ka assessment, training aur hifazat kaise karein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain the breathlessness spiral, assess with the MRC dyspnoea scale and a walk test, prescribe endurance and strength training for a 6 to 8 week programme, use oxygen saturation safely and teach recovery positions.
goal.ur: End tak aap saans phoolne ka chakkar samjhayenge, MRC dyspnoea scale aur walk test se assessment karenge, 6 se 8 hafte ke programme ke liye endurance aur strength training likhenge, oxygen saturation ko mehfooz tareeqe se istemal karenge aur recovery positions sikhayenge.

text.en: **Pulmonary rehabilitation** is a supervised programme of **exercise training and education**, usually **twice a week for 6 to 8 weeks**, for people with chronic lung disease who are limited by breathlessness (typically **MRC grade 3 or above**). It does not change lung function tests much, but it trains the **leg and arm muscles** to use oxygen better, reduces the fear of breathlessness, and teaches self-management. People have less breathlessness, walk further, feel better and are **readmitted to hospital less often** after a flare-up.
text.ur: **Pulmonary rehabilitation** **exercise training aur taleem** ka nigrani wala programme hai, aam taur par **hafte mein do baar 6 se 8 hafte**, purani phephron ki bimari walon ke liye jinhein saans phoolna rokta hai (aam taur par **MRC grade 3 ya zyada**). Yeh lung function tests ko zyada nahi badalta, magar **taangon aur bazuon ke muscles** ko oxygen behtar istemal karna sikhata hai, saans phoolne ka khauf kam karta hai, aur apna khayal rakhna sikhata hai. Logon ki saans kam phoolti hai, woh zyada chal paate hain, behtar mehsoos karte hain aur flare ke baad **hospital mein dobara kam dakhil** hote hain.

text.en: COPD lungs are like a **small, old engine** you cannot replace. Pulmonary rehab does not rebuild the engine; it makes the **car lighter and more efficient** — stronger muscles need less oxygen for the same work, and a calmer driver wastes less fuel.
text.ur: COPD wale phephre ek **chhote, purane engine** jaise hain jo badla nahi ja sakta. Pulmonary rehab engine dobara nahi banata; yeh **gaari ko halka aur behtar** banata hai — mazboot muscles ko ek hi kaam ke liye kam oxygen chahiye, aur pursukoon driver kam fuel zaya karta hai.

steps.title: Assess at the start
steps.detail: Record the MRC dyspnoea grade, a walk test (6-minute walk or incremental shuttle walk), oxygen saturation at rest and on exercise, and a quality-of-life score (for example CAT). Check that medicines and inhalers are being used correctly. || Shuru mein assessment

steps.title: Endurance training
steps.detail: Walking or cycling for about 20 to 30 minutes in total (intervals are fine), at a breathlessness of about 3 to 4 on the 0 to 10 Borg scale, or about 60 to 80 percent of the walk-test speed. || Endurance training

steps.title: Strength training
steps.detail: Legs and arms: sit-to-stand, step-ups, wall push-ups, arm raises with light weights; 2 to 3 sets of 8 to 12 repetitions, progressed when easy. Breathe out on the effort. || Strength training

steps.title: Teach recovery and self-management
steps.detail: Forward-lean positions, pursed-lip breathing and pacing to recover from breathlessness; inhaler technique; spotting a flare-up early; staying active after the programme ends. || Recovery aur apna khayal sikhayein

question.en: What does pulmonary rehabilitation mainly improve?
question.ur: Pulmonary rehabilitation zyada tar kya behtar karti hai?

text.en: It mainly raises FEV1 to normal
text.ur: Yeh zyada tar FEV1 ko normal kar deti hai

feedback.ur: Lung function bohat kam badalta hai.

text.en: It cures the damage in the lungs
text.ur: Yeh phephron ka nuqsan theek kar deti hai

text.en: Breathlessness, exercise capacity and quality of life, through trained muscles and better self-management
text.ur: Saans phoolna, exercise ki salahiyat aur zindagi ka maiyar, trained muscles aur behtar khud-nigrani ke zariye

feedback.en: Yes — the lungs change little; the person changes a lot.
feedback.ur: Haan — phephre kam badalte hain; insaan bohat badalta hai.

rows.ur: Kam saans phoolne ke saath zyada chalna
Rozmarra kaamon ke liye mazboot taangen

rows.en: Intervals if continuous is too hard

text.en: **Breathless is not dangerous; desaturation is.** Being out of breath during exercise is expected and safe. A falling oxygen saturation is what needs action.
text.ur: **Saans phoolna khatarnak nahi; saturation girna hai.** Exercise mein saans phoolna mutawaqqa aur mehfooz hai. Oxygen saturation ka girna woh cheez hai jis par qadam uthana zaroori hai.

text.en: **Stopping exercise every time the patient is breathless.** Short-lived, recoverable breathlessness is the training stimulus. Teach a recovery position and pursed-lip breathing, let it settle, and carry on. Stop for chest pain, dizziness, or saturation that falls and does not recover.
text.ur: **Har baar saans phoolne par exercise rok dena.** Thori der ka, theek ho jane wala saans phoolna hi training ka stimulus hai. Recovery position aur pursed-lip breathing sikhayein, sambhalne dein, aur jaari rakhein. Seene ke dard, chakkar, ya girti aur wapas na aane wali saturation par rok dein.

question.en: During a walk, saturation drops from 94 to 86 percent and stays low after a rest. What should you do?
question.ur: Chalte hue saturation 94 se 86 percent par gir jati hai aur aaram ke baad bhi kam rehti hai. Kya karna chahiye?

text.en: Ignore it; pulse oximeters are often wrong
text.ur: Nazarandaz karein; pulse oximeter aksar ghalat hote hain

feedback.en: Check the reading (good signal, warm fingers), but act on a true fall.
feedback.ur: Reading check karein (achha signal, garam ungliyan), magar asal girawat par qadam uthayein.

text.en: Stop, rest, follow the oxygen plan and discuss oxygen during exercise with the medical team
text.ur: Rok dein, aaram karayein, oxygen plan par amal karein aur exercise mein oxygen ke baare mein medical team se baat karein

feedback.en: Yes — sustained desaturation needs assessment, often oxygen on exertion.
feedback.ur: Haan — musalsal kam saturation ko assessment chahiye, aksar mehnat par oxygen.

text.en: Push on — breathlessness is good training
text.ur: Jaari rakhein — saans phoolna achhi training hai

feedback.en: Breathlessness is fine; sustained low oxygen is not.
feedback.ur: Saans phoolna theek hai; musalsal kam oxygen nahi.

question.en: When is the best time to start pulmonary rehabilitation after a hospital stay for a COPD flare-up?
question.ur: COPD flare ke baad hospital se aane par pulmonary rehabilitation kab shuru karna behtar hai?

text.en: Never — it is unsafe after a flare-up
text.ur: Kabhi nahi — flare ke baad yeh ghair-mehfooz hai

feedback.en: Supervised rehab after a flare is safe and recommended.
feedback.ur: Flare ke baad nigrani wala rehab mehfooz aur tajweez kiya gaya hai.

text.ur: Discharge ke takreeban 4 hafte ke andar

feedback.en: Yes — early rehab after a flare reduces readmissions.
feedback.ur: Haan — flare ke baad jaldi rehab dobara dakhil hone ko kam karta hai.

text.en: Only after a year of stability
text.ur: Sirf ek saal ki behtari ke baad

feedback.en: Waiting loses the window of benefit.
feedback.ur: Intezar faide ka waqt zaya kar deta hai.

text.en: **Make it fit local life.** Many patients have smoked or cooked over wood or dung fires for years. Use stairs, walking routes in the neighbourhood and water bottles as weights, and run the programme where transport is easy. A family member who learns the exercises helps the patient keep going after the 8 weeks.
text.ur: **Isay maqami zindagi ke mutabiq banayein.** Bohat se mareez saalon se cigarette peete rahe ya lakri ya uplon ki aag par khana pakate rahe. Seedhiyan, mohalle ke chalne ke raaste aur pani ki botalen wazan ke taur par istemal karein, aur programme wahan chalayein jahan aana jana aasan ho. Exercises seekhne wala ghar ka fard mareez ko 8 hafte ke baad bhi jaari rakhne mein madad deta hai.

question.en: Why does training the legs help a lung disease?
question.ur: Taangon ki training phephron ki bimari mein kyun madad karti hai?

answer.en: In COPD the leg muscles become weak and inefficient from inactivity and inflammation, so they produce lactate early and drive faster breathing. Trained muscles do the same work with less oxygen and less carbon dioxide, so breathing demand falls and the person can walk further before becoming breathless.
answer.ur: COPD mein ghair-fa'aaliyat aur sozish se taangon ke muscles kamzor aur kam-kaar ho jate hain, is liye woh jaldi lactate banate hain aur saans tez karwate hain. Trained muscles wohi kaam kam oxygen aur kam carbon dioxide ke saath karte hain, is liye saans ki zaroorat kam hoti hai aur shakhs saans phoolne se pehle zyada chal sakta hai.

beats.patient: A 64-year-old former smoker with COPD (MRC grade 4) stops after 100 metres to catch his breath. His 6-minute walk is 240 metres, his resting saturation is 93 percent and falls to 89 percent on walking, recovering within a minute of rest.
beats.assessment: He is a typical candidate for pulmonary rehabilitation; brief, recovering desaturation can be managed with interval training and monitoring.
beats.treatment: An 8-week programme, twice weekly: interval walking at Borg 3 to 4, sit-to-stand and arm exercises, pursed-lip breathing and forward-lean recovery, inhaler check and a home walking plan.
beats.reassess: His walk increases to 310 metres, he climbs stairs at home with one rest instead of three, and he keeps walking daily with his son.

text.en: **Stop and seek medical help** for chest pain, new or rapidly worsening breathlessness at rest, confusion or drowsiness, blue lips, coughing blood, or saturation that stays well below the patient's target despite rest. **Delay rehab** during an acute flare-up, uncontrolled heart failure or unstable angina. Patients on oxygen must follow their prescribed flow; a target of 88 to 92 percent is common for people at risk of carbon dioxide retention.
text.ur: **Rok kar medical madad lein** seene mein dard, aaram mein nayi ya tezi se barhti saans ki takleef, uljhan ya ghunoodgi, neele honth, khoon wali khansi, ya aaram ke bawajood mareez ke target se kaafi kam rehne wali saturation par. **Rehab mulatvi karein** shadeed flare, be-qaboo heart failure ya unstable angina ke dauran. Oxygen wale mareez apna likha hua flow follow karein; carbon dioxide rokne ke khatre walon ke liye 88 se 92 percent aam target hai.

summary.en: Pulmonary rehabilitation is 6 to 8 weeks of supervised exercise and education for people limited by breathlessness (MRC 3 and above).
summary.ur: Pulmonary rehabilitation saans phoolne se mehdood logon (MRC 3 aur zyada) ke liye 6 se 8 hafte ki nigrani wali exercise aur taleem hai.

summary.en: Train endurance (20 to 30 minutes at Borg 3 to 4, intervals allowed) and strength (2 to 3 sets of 8 to 12), and teach recovery positions and pursed-lip breathing.
summary.ur: Endurance (Borg 3 se 4 par 20 se 30 minute, intervals ki ijazat) aur strength (8 se 12 ke 2 se 3 sets) ki training dein, aur recovery positions aur pursed-lip breathing sikhayein.

summary.en: Breathlessness is expected; sustained desaturation, chest pain and confusion are not — and rehab started soon after a flare-up reduces readmissions.
summary.ur: Saans phoolna mutawaqqa hai; musalsal saturation girna, seene ka dard aur uljhan nahi — aur flare ke baad jaldi shuru kiya rehab dobara dakhil hone ko kam karta hai.

front.en: Who is referred to pulmonary rehab?
front.ur: Pulmonary rehab ke liye kis ko bheja jata hai?

back.en: People with chronic lung disease limited by breathlessness, usually MRC grade 3 or above.
back.ur: Purani phephron ki bimari wale jinhein saans phoolna rokta hai, aam taur par MRC grade 3 ya zyada.

back.en: 6 to 8 weeks, about twice a week, supervised.
back.ur: 6 se 8 hafte, takreeban hafte mein do baar, nigrani mein.

front.ur: Endurance training mein saans phoolne ka target?

back.en: About 3 to 4 on the 0 to 10 Borg scale.
back.ur: 0 se 10 Borg scale par takreeban 3 se 4.

front.en: Best time to start after a flare-up?
front.ur: Flare ke baad shuru karne ka behtareen waqt?

back.en: Within about 4 weeks of hospital discharge.
back.ur: Hospital se discharge ke takreeban 4 hafte ke andar.
